purpose: Verify the HMAC signature and expiry of the parsed proposal acceptance token before any acceptance action is allowed.

node.name: Security - Verify HMAC Signature and Expiry
node.notes: Phase 3.0.1.4. This node establishes trust only after signature and expiry both pass. Never accept the proposal before token_verified=true.

implementation_notes: Uses the same PROPOSAL_ACCEPT_HMAC_SECRET used by 3.0.1.1.
Expiry is checked against Unix time in seconds.
A valid signature with an expired timestamp is rejected.
A forged signature is rejected even if the token structure is valid.
test_cases: Correct secret + expired token => token_verified=false and ACCEPT_TOKEN_EXPIRED.
